text:
Type: pale green three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for a lamp or decor; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: painted fiberboard in a smooth matte finish
Colors: light sage green, soft grey-green
Shape: plain boxy cabinet with three wide flush drawers, handleless fronts with a top-edge grip recess, slim overhanging top, recessed plinth, clean sharp edges, medium visual weight
Feel: soft, calm, fresh, gentle
Goes with: white walls, light oak, natural linen, green plants; Scandinavian or minimalist bedrooms

product.name: MALM
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
